attributes.name: Bestial Rags
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to reduce Cold or Combat damage dealt to you by 2.

Banish this card to reduce Cold or Combat damage dealt to you to 0; if you have the Survival skill, bury it instead. 

If you have the Druid, Hunter, Ranger, or Shifter trait, you may recharge this card to recharge a spell that has the Animal trait from your discard pile.
